prose.subject: Friendly Reminder: Invoice INV-30756 from Dunmore Cloud
prose.body:
Hi Corvane Labs team,

Hope you're having a great week! This is just a quick, friendly nudge regarding invoice INV-30756 for 5810.62 USDC. We noticed this payment is currently pending and wanted to make sure it didn't slip through the cracks.

To settle the balance, please send the funds to our standard vendor wallet: 0xfe3d8b944667403f645b57a1800ea126ba77c2ec.

If you have already sent this, feel free to ignore this note or reply with the transaction hash so we can update our records. If you have any questions about the invoice details or need a PDF copy re-sent, just let us know. We appreciate your prompt attention to this.

Best regards,

Billing Team
Dunmore Cloud
support@dunmore-cloud.example
